arxiv-2105-12535.creator: P S Negi
arxiv-2105-12535.description: Abstract The central (surface) energy-density, E 0 ​ ( E R ) E_{0}(E_{R}) , which appears in the expression of total static and spherical mass, M M (corresponding to the total radius R R ) is defined as the density measured only by one observer located at the centre (surface) in the Momentarily Co-moving Reference Frame (MCRF).

arxiv-2209-00294.title: Chiral Quantum Phases and Tricriticality in a Dicke Triangle
arxiv-2209-00294.creator: Guo-Jing Cheng, Diego Fallas Padilla, Tao Deng, Yu-Yu Zhang, Han Pu
arxiv-2209-00294.description: Abstract The existence of quantum tricriticality and exotic phases are found in a Dicke triangle (TDT) where three cavities, each one containing an ensemble of three-level atoms, are connected to each other through the action of an artificial magnetic field.

arxiv-2211-12283.title: On the evolution of the particle distribution and the cascade in a moving, expanding emission region in blazar jets
arxiv-2211-12283.creator: Michael Zacharias 1,2
arxiv-2211-12283.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Michael Zacharias 1,2. There is a large variety in the models explaining blazar flares. Here, we study the flare profile induced by a moving and expanding blob with special emphasize on the γ \gamma - γ \gamma pair production. We first develop a simple semi-analytical model to study the evolution of the particle distribution in the expanding blob and show the influence of the pair production.

arxiv-2307-02417.title: 3D Multi-Robot Exploration with a Two-Level Coordination Strategy and Prioritization
arxiv-2307-02417.creator: Luigi Freda, Tiago Novo, David Portugal, Rui P. Rocha
arxiv-2307-02417.description: Abstract This work presents a 3D multi-robot exploration framework for a team of UGVs moving on uneven terrains. The framework was designed by casting the two-level coordination strategy presented in [ 1 ] into the context of multi-robot exploration. The resulting distributed exploration technique minimizes and explicitly manages the occurrence of conflicts and interferences in the robot team.

arxiv-2311-14437.title: Variational Approach to Excited Fermions on Kinks
arxiv-2311-14437.creator: Herbert Weigel a) , Danial Saadatmand a),b)
arxiv-2311-14437.description: Abstract We study the back-reaction of fermion fields on the kink solution in one space and one time dimension. We employ a variational procedure to determine an upper limit for the minimum of the total energy. This energy has three contributions: the classical kink energy, the energy of valence fermions and the fermion vacuum polarization energy.

arxiv-2405-15878.title: Constraints on compact dark matter from the non-observation of gravitational-wave strong lensing
arxiv-2405-15878.creator: A. Barsode 1, S. J. Kapadia 2,1, P. Ajith 1,3
arxiv-2405-15878.description: Abstract We use the non-observation of strong lensing of gravitational waves (GWs) in the first three observation runs of LIGO-Virgo detectors to constrain the fraction of dark matter in the form of compact objects in the mass range 10 6 − 10 9 ​ M ⊙ 10^{6}-10^{9}~{{\mathrm{M}_{\odot}}} .

arxiv-2408-13424.title: Enabling Humanitarian Applications with Targeted Differential Privacy
arxiv-2408-13424.creator: Nitin Kohli, Joshua E. Blumenstock
arxiv-2408-13424.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Nitin Kohli, Joshua E. Blumenstock. The proliferation of mobile phones in low- and middle-income countries has suddenly and dramatically increased the extent to which the world’s poorest and most vulnerable populations can be observed and tracked by governments and corporations. Millions of historically “off the grid” individuals are now passively generating digital data; these data, in turn, are being used to make life-altering decisions about those individuals — including whether or not they receive government benefits, and whether they qualify for a consumer loan.

arxiv-2409-03305.title: Derangements in non-Frobenius groups
arxiv-2409-03305.creator: Daniele Garzoni
arxiv-2409-03305.description: Abstract . We prove that if G G is a transitive permutation group of sufficiently large degree n n , then either G G is primitive and Frobenius, or the proportion of derangements in G G is larger than 1 / ( 2 ​ n 1 / 2 ) 1/(2n^{1/2}) .

arxiv-2409-04797.creator: involving the Logarithmic Laplacian
arxiv-2409-04797.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by involving the Logarithmic Laplacian. 1 Introduction Let \mathcal{L}_{\Delta} be the logarthmic Laplacian in \mathbb{R}^{n} with n\in\mathbb{N} , the set of positive integers, initiated in [ 14 ] , defined by \mathcal{L}_{\Delta}u(x)=c_{n}\int_{\mathbb{R}^{n}}\frac{u(x)1_{B_{1}(x)}(y)-u(y)}{|x-y|^{n}}dy+\rho_{n}u(x), where c_{n}\!:=\pi^{-n/2}\Gamma(n/2)=\frac{2}{\omega_{{n-1}}},\qquad\rho_{n}\!:=2\ln 2+\psi(\tfrac{n}{2})-\gamma, \omega_{{n-1}}:=|\mathbb{S}^{n-1}| , the area of the unit sphere of \mathbb{R}^{n} , and \gamma=-\Gamma^{\prime}(1) is the Euler Mascheroni constant, \psi=\frac{\Gamma^{\prime}}{\Gamma} is the digamma function associated to the Gamma function \Gamma .

arxiv-2411-16270.title: On involutions of minuscule Kirillov algebras induced by real structures
arxiv-2411-16270.creator: Mischa Elkner
arxiv-2411-16270.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Mischa Elkner. We study Kirillov algebras attached to minuscule highest weight representations of semisimple Lie algebras. They can be viewed as equivariant cohomology algebras of partial flag varieties. Real structures on the varieties then induce involutions of these algebras. We describe how these involutions act on the spectra of minuscule Kirillov algebras, and model the fixed points via the equivariant cohomology of real partial flag varieties. We then use this model to characterise freeness of the fixed point coordinate ring over the appropriate base.

arxiv-2502-06933.title: A fast and robust recipe for modeling non-ideal MHD effects in star-formation simulations
arxiv-2502-06933.creator: E. Agianoglou, A. Tritsis ,, K. Tassis
arxiv-2502-06933.description: Abstract Context. Non-ideal magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) effects are thought to be a crucial component of the star-formation process. Numerically, several complications render the study of non-ideal MHD effects in 3-dimensional (3D) simulations extremely challenging and hinder our efforts of exploring a large parameter space. Aims.

arxiv-2505-20488.title: Symmetry breaking in time-dependent billiards
arxiv-2505-20488.creator: 1 Anne Kétri P. da Fonseca, 1 Edson D. Leonel
arxiv-2505-20488.description: Abstract We investigate symmetry breaking in a time-dependent billiard that undergoes a continuous phase transition when dissipation is introduced. The system presents unlimited velocity, and thus energy growth for the conservative dynamics. When inelastic collisions are introduced between the particle and the boundary, the velocity reaches a plateau after the crossover iteration.

arxiv-2507-10755.title: Auditing Facial Emotion Recognition Datasets for Posed Expressions and Racial Bias
arxiv-2507-10755.creator: Rina Khan, Catherine Stinson
arxiv-2507-10755.description: Abstract Facial expression recognition (FER) algorithms classify facial expressions into emotions such as happy, sad, or angry. An evaluative challenge facing FER algorithms is the fall in performance when detecting spontaneous expressions compared to posed expressions. An ethical (and evaluative) challenge facing FER algorithms is that they tend to perform poorly for people of some races and skin colors.

arxiv-2601-15173.title: Upper Bounds on Covering Minima of Convex Bodies
arxiv-2601-15173.creator: Katarina Krivokuća
arxiv-2601-15173.description: Abstract . We give two new upper bounds on the covering minima of convex bodies, depending on covering minima of certain projections and intersections with linear subspaces. We show one bound to be sharp for direct sums of two convex bodies, generalizing previous results on the covering radius and lattice width of direct sums.

pmc-12592358.title: Effective descriptions of bosonic systems can be considered complete
pmc-12592358.creator: Francesco Arzani, Robert I Booth, Ulysse Chabaud
pmc-12592358.description: Bosonic statistics give rise to remarkable phenomena, from the Hong–Ou–Mandel effect to Bose–Einstein condensation, with applications spanning fundamental science to quantum technologies. pmc-12841850.creator: Henny R Thanki, Suril Vithalani
pmc-12841850.description: Meckel’s diverticulum is the most frequent congenital anomaly of the gastrointestinal tract, yet its identification can be challenging when symptoms mimic those of more common conditions. In adolescents, this often leads to misdirection during the diagnosis and delays in identifying the true source of bleeding. A 16-year-old male presented with recurrent melena and abdominal pain.

pmc-13027477.title: Inflammatory Endotypes of Chronic Adenoiditis and Their Impact on Persistent Middle Ear Dysfunction: A 2-Year Retrospective Translational Study Integrating Clustering and Machine Learning Approaches

This study aimed to identify inflammatory endotypes of chronic adenoiditis using unsupervised clustering and to evaluate their association with PMED through mechanistic and predictive modeling.

pmc-13059362.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13373110.title: Liquid crystal thermography for breast cancer detection: principles, current evidence, limitations, and future directions
pmc-13373110.creator: Ainnur Bazilah Mohd Sha’ari, Heba Mohammed Arafat, Tengku Ahmad Damitri Al Astani Tengku Din, Bazli Md Yusoff, Ohood Mohammed Shamallakh, Wan Faiziah Wan Abdul Rahman

pmc-13421509.creator: Rachel Chen, Joodi Mourhli, Ben Bowers, Jonathan Koffman, Stephen Barclay, Anna Spathis, Simon Etkind
pmc-13421509.description: BackgroundUncertainty is ubiquitous in serious illness. Vactosertib was administered five days per week at predefined dose levels in combination with pembrolizumab (200 mg intravenously every three weeks).
